home.title: Physiotherapy in the Plateau-Mont-Royal
home.intro: Assessment, treatment, and sports or post-surgery rehabilitation with a team of six physiotherapists.
home.hoursText: Choose your service, your physiotherapist and a time that suits you.

availability.title: Availability
availability.noSlots: No availability this week. Try another week or another physiotherapist.

status.error: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again in a moment.

footer.fictional: Student project: fictional clinic and data.

account.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.intro: Enter the email address of your account. We will send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for this address, a link has just been sent to it. It is valid for 30 minutes. Also check your spam folder.

reset.title: New password
reset.rules: At least 12 characters, without your email address. A phrase of several words is easy to remember.
reset.tooShort: The password must have at least 12 characters.
reset.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
reset.weak: The password must not contain your email address.
reset.invalid: This link is no longer valid (it was already used or it has expired).
reset.done: Your password has been changed. You can now log in. For your security, all your open sessions were closed.

verify.title: Email address confirmation
verify.done: Your email address is confirmed. You can now log in.
verify.invalid: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired.
